Sub:   Disclosure of material event/information under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (Listing Regulations, 2015) 
 
 
This has reference to our letter dated October 28, 2026, wherein it was informed that Conference Call to 
discuss Unaudited Financial Results for quarter ended September 30, 2026 is scheduled on Monday, 
November 2, 2026 at 4:00 PM (IST).  
 
However, due to unavoidable circumstances, this is to inform that the said Conference Call has been 
postponed to Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 4:00 PM (IST). Invite of the same is enclosed.  
 
Please note that above information is subject to change.
